about: lib/order-edit.js applyJobEdit and a part's colour (Dev Hub, Nov 18): colour is not money. A colour-only change never reprices and never asks keep-or-new, on a price the customer has seen, and a finished job may still correct it. Frozen jobs stay locked. The Mac and the phone run this file.

cases.why: a seen price (a booked job): a colour-only change saves, the price stays, nothing is asked
the same without priceSeenOk or keepPrice: still no question, because nothing priced moved
a finished job (materials deducted: names only) may still correct a colour
taking a colour off (an empty value: a part is merged over its old copy, so leaving the field out keeps it) saves, no reprice
a voided job stays locked, colour included
a job reported to ZATCA stays locked
